rows.text: with the key the byte range from qword `[r8]` to qword `[r8+8]`, descends from qword `rcx+0x18`, comparing the key with each node's range at qwords `+0x20`/`+0x28` through `001A3F10` + 0x68 (over the shorter length, a tie decided by length) and following qword `+8` when the key is smaller, else qword `+0`; with `n` the last node visited (`rcx+8`, counted as smaller, when the root is null): when the last step was smaller and `n` equals qword `rcx+0x10` it inserts at once; otherwise it compares `p` (`001A3F10` + 0xAF(`n`) after a smaller step, else `n`) with the key through `001A3F10` + 0xD8 and, unless `p` is smaller, stores `p` at qword `[rdx]` and 0 at byte `rdx+8`; to insert it calls `001A3F10` + 0x107 (`001A3F10` + 0x13B on the other path)(`rcx`, `r8`, `n+0x20`) unless `n` is `rcx+8`, sets a flag when that returns 0, calls `001A3F10` + 0x163(`001A3F10` + 0x11B (`001A3F10` + 0x14F)(`rcx`, `r8`), `n`, `rcx+8`, flag), increments dword `rcx+0x28` and stores that result at `[rdx]` and 1 at byte `rdx+8`; returns `rdx`

copies qword `[rdx]` to `[rcx]`; zeroes qwords `rcx+8` and `rcx+0x10`, calls `001EDF00(rcx+0x18, rdx+0x18)`, points qwords `rcx+8` and `rcx+0x10` at `rcx+8`, and calls `001BC8C0(rcx+8, rcx+8, qword [rdx+8], rdx+8)` with the low byte of `rcx+8` as the fifth (stack) argument; returns `rcx`

sets a flag to 1 when the low byte of the fifth (stack) argument is 0, `r8` is not `rcx+8` and qword `[r9]` is not below qword `[r8+0x20]` (unsigned), else 0; calls slot `+0x10` of the vtable of the object at `rcx+0x30` with (`rcx+0x30`, `0x40`, 0) for `n`, calls `001BD340` + 0x75(`n+0x20`, `r9`) when `n+0x20` is non-null, then `001BD340` + 0x88(`n`, `r8`, `rcx+8`, flag); increments dword `rcx+0x28`, stores `n` at qword `[rdx]` and returns `rdx`
